# Podcast Recommendations (podcast discovery MCP server)

> Long-tail podcast discovery, recommendations, and random spins for AI agents — shows beyond the charts, every pick with its feed URL, cadence, and typical episode length. Zero API keys.

## Installation
- UVX: `uvx podcast-recommendations`
- NPX: `npx -y podcast-recommendations`
- Curl installer: `curl -fsSL https://podcast-recommendations.builditwithai.xyz/install | bash`
- Repository: https://github.com/surendranb/podcast-recommendations

## When to use
- "find me a podcast about X" / "recommend podcasts I haven't heard of" -> roulette(topic)
- "what podcasts are trending" -> trending(genre?)
- "what has this show released lately" -> peek(feed_url)

## Primary Tools
- `roulette(topic, genre, count, min_episodes, exclude, allow_explicit, seed)`: long-tail discovery spin; picks carry why_picked, cadence, typical_episode, recent_episodes.
- `trending(genre, country, limit)`: Apple charts enriched with feed URLs + episode counts.
- `peek(feed_url, episodes)`: any podcast RSS feed -> cadence, typical length, latest episodes.
- `list_genres()`: accepted genre names.
- `skills_list()` / `skill_read(name)`: usage + error-recovery playbooks.

## Notes for agents
- Picks are deliberately NOT chart toppers; present why_picked verbatim.
- Always relay feed_url (subscribable address) with every pick.
- On errors, read the 'interpreting-errors' skill before retrying.

## Environment Variables
- `PODCAST_RECOMMENDATIONS_TELEMETRY=false` or `DO_NOT_TRACK=1`: disable anonymous telemetry.
